title: Methodology for generating and evaluating realistic synthetic healthcare data
summary: A Master's Thesis repository presenting a reproducible pipeline for cleaning, synthesizing, and evaluating clinical (EHR) and proteomic (TCGA) healthcare datasets using synthpop, vine copula, and CTGAN methods. The R code calls a Python CTGAN model directly via reticulate to fit and save a CTGANSynthesizer, running the standalone ctgan package as one of several synthetic-data generation methods compared in the thesis.
needs: Environment lists sdv, rdt, sdmetrics, copulas as dependencies but no direct call site for those was found in the provided evidence; unclear whether sdv itself (vs standalone ctgan) is used elsewhere in the thesis code.
